summary: The customer wants to assess whether a fiber-based measurement in the feed frame of a tablet press could follow API concentration changes in a powder blend, and to compare measurement options before committing to production equipment.

facts_stated.text: We manufacture tablets from a powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients.

facts_stated.text: Laboratory checks tell us whether the blend is on target, but results arrive after the material has moved through the press.
